question: What claim is made about who told the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters?
premises: A teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by an earth-mover.
It is addressed to the beloved one.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved one.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved one.
